title: forge-bundle.json, version 1 (s2u.creator/forge-map-bundle)
description: The envelope of a forge-map bundle (FP-4, FP.R2; a browser adaptation with no original): one zip carrying a Forge layout and the creator packs it stands on, forge-bundle.json at the zip's root or inside exactly one top folder. This schema is the envelope's shape only, for editors; the contract's validator (packages/creator-contracts/src/bundle.ts, validateForgeBundle) is the authority: it reads the layout through the record's own reader, validates each pack whole under its root as a v2 pack, checks each ref against the pack's digest, and lists the required packs the bundle does not carry.

packs.description: Each pack the bundle carries, by its reference and the folder that holds it whole. A pack the layout requires and the bundle does not carry is listed missing by the validator, not refused.

packRef.description: A pack's identity (PackRef): its id, its SemVer version, and its hash -- the pack digest (SHA-256 over the canonical manifest, digest s2u.pack version 1), 64 lower-case hex digits.

root.description: The pack's folder under the envelope, ending /: s2u-pack.json at its top, every member under it. Each segment as a pack path's (packs.ts packPath): not empty, not . or .., not starting with a dot, not ending with a dot or a space, no / \ : % < > " | ? * or control character; the whole ending /. The validator also refuses a reserved device name and a depth over 16.

layoutRecordV3.description: A Forge layout record, version 3 (forge-layout). Only its identity is held here; every other field is the record's own reader's (packages/creator-contracts/src/layout.ts, readCreatorRecord).

poses.description: A tilted or scaled piece's pose (FX-1), present only when the layout has one: rows [pieceIndex, pitch, roll, sx, sy, sz], each piece at most once and in piece order. Pitch is a whole degree in -90..90 and roll in 0..359, in the YXZ order beside the piece row's own yaw (at a pitch of 90 or -90 the roll is 0); each scale a multiple of 0.01 within 0.1..4; never a row for a piece neither tilted nor scaled. The bounds and the order are the record's reader's (layout.ts posesError).
